summary: The audition page has a spatial stage. Switch: Mono / Stereo (loudspeakers, default) / Headphones (HRTF, 1.5 m circle). One-channel sounds sit at their manifest place (or a new random direction per trigger for 'event' or no place; combat hits come from changing sides); two-channel files play as they are, and as their mono sum in Mono. Every sound feeds the cabin_ir through a send (dry: full, baked: 0.25), one Room slider scales both. A rated sound whose file hash differs from the hash of its rating is marked, dimmed, counted and filterable. Fourth scene 'Faltsprung' with the fold chain. Check green: 39 passed, tsc clean. To run: server `cd packages/client && AUDITION_RATINGS_FILE=<scratch file> npx vite --port 5184 --strictPort`, check `AUDITION_RATINGS_FILE=<same file> AUDITION_URL=http://localhost:5184/dev/audition.html node tools/dev/audition-check.mjs`.
changed: NEW FOR THE OWNER (read first): a 'Buehne' bar under the header with Mono / Stereo (Lautsprecher) / Kopfhoerer and a Raum slider. Stereo is the default. Switching while a sound plays re-places it at once. Each row of a one-channel sound shows its place ('Ort 90°', 'Ort nach Ereignis', 'Ort zufaellig'); two-channel files show 'zwei Kanaele' and are never moved. The save status moved into this bar.

NEW FOR THE OWNER: 'Seit der Bewertung geaendert' mark on a row whose file was rendered again after he rated it. The old stars, verdict and note stay visible but dimmed until he rates again; the counter reads '20 / 118 bewertet, 98 unbewertet, 10 geaendert' style; a new filter 'Seit meiner Bewertung geaendert' lists those rows and keeps a row in the list when it is re-rated (same as the unrated filter). Right now 10 of his 20 ratings differ from their round-1 hash in the live manifest (engine idle, three shield hits, shields-down alarm, cruise charge, cruise loop, fold jump, fold tunnel, fold exit).

NEW FOR THE OWNER: fourth tab 'Faltsprung': cruise loop on/off, buttons 1 Falt laden, 2 Faltsprung, 3 Falttunnel an/aus, 4 Faltaustritt, 5 Stille Kabine, and two whole-chain buttons (one or two tunnel passes). The written sequence runs the two-pass chain at 4 s and ends with the quiet cabin. Chains start each sound at the manifest cue of the one before (else 20 ms before its end); tunnel passes are laid end to end with no overlap so the loop seam stays intact; the cruise leaves at the start of the jump.

engine.ts: new graph. Voice -> gain -> stage (per voice: StereoPannerNode behind a low-pass that closes toward 3.5 kHz behind; or HRTF PannerNode at 1.5 m; or untouched) -> bakedIn / dryIn. Both inputs have a send into the one convolver; bus -> mono mix (channelCount 1, explicit, only in Mono) -> volume (always 2 channels). Sends: dry sounds direct 1-0.7*room and send room (as before at room 1); baked sounds send 0.25*room; the Cabin switch sets all sends to 0. Engine group levels share one place (first level's place, else ahead) so the crossfade stays one engine. Test hooks: plays[].azimuth, peakLMax/peakRMax, sendLevels().

ratings.ts / types.ts: each new rating stores the file hash ('hash'); a rating without one is compared with assets/audio/rounds/round1.json (loaded read-only). Re-rating a changed sound starts a fresh rating (the note stays to edit) and moves the old one into an additive 'history' list, so nothing is dropped from localStorage or ratings.json; the file shape (version 1) is unchanged apart from the new optional fields. Manifest types gain hash, place, cue and path 'energy' (badge 'Energie').

scenes.ts / sceneRunner.ts / ScenesView.tsx: scenes may have no engine family and a chosen set of sliders; shots can set a direction ('alternate' for combat hits: -65, 70, -120, 110, -35, 40 degrees in turn), play one pass of a loop, start seamlessly, and switch state at their start. Stop (Alles stoppen, Szene stoppen, Ton stoppen) now also ends scheduled shots and cancels their state changes; the natural end of a written sequence lets the tails ring out as before.
auditionPlugin.ts: serves assets/audio/rounds/ read-only. New optional env AUDITION_RATINGS_FILE keeps the ratings of a test server in another file (the owner's ratings.json is then never touched).

tools/dev/audition-check.mjs: now REQUIRES AUDITION_RATINGS_FILE (exits 2 without it, or when it points at the owner's file), because the check writes ratings and the owner is rating live; the old backup/restore of the real file would have overwritten his ratings. 14 new checks (see verified). Scroll offsets raised by 45 px for the new header bar.
screenshots/audition: stage-header-de.png, library-changed-mark.png, scene-fold-idle.png, scene-fold-running.png added; all older ones retaken in German with the new header.
verified: node tools/dev/audition-check.mjs against my vite on 5184 (ratings in a scratch file): 39 passed, 0 failed, last run after all edits. Real-speed peaks with the limiter off: docking -5.6 dBFS, combat -3.8, landing -10.1 (the Room sends did not push any scene to clipping).

Stage: Stereo default; labels German and English; a place-90 test tone is >10x louder on the right in Stereo with Room 0; a place-0 tone is even; in Mono both channels equal; in Headphones the right is more than 1.2x the left and the logged azimuth is 90; a generated left-only two-channel file keeps its channels (right < 2 % of left) in Stereo and Headphones and in Mono both channels are equal at half the left level and the file gets no direction; a sound without place gets at least 4 different directions in 8 triggers; switching the stage while a loop runs keeps it sounding; the panning, behind-cutoff and 1.5 m circle maths (mirror pan, 3.5 kHz behind) are asserted on the real functions.

Room: send levels at Room 1 (dry 1, baked 0.25), Room 0.5 (half), Cabin off (all 0, direct 1); audible tail after a dry tone at Room 1 and none at Room 0; a baked tone's tail exists and is quieter than the dry one.

Changed mark with doctored hashes: fresh rating stores its hash; after the manifest hash changes the row shows the German mark, keeps 4 lit stars, is dimmed (opacity < 0.9), counter reads '2 geaendert', round-1 case (rating without hash: marked when the file differs from round1.json, not marked when it matches); filter lists exactly the changed rows and keeps a re-rated row; rating again clears the mark, stores the new hash and a history entry with the old stars and hash (read back from the ratings file).

Fold scene: 8 event buttons, no missing sounds, no thrust slider; chain with a doctored cue of 2 s on fold_charge starts the jump exactly 2 s later (< 1 ms), the first tunnel pass at the jump's cue (or 20 ms before its end), the second pass exactly at the end of the first, the exit 20 ms before the end of the last pass; the cruise switch turns off with the jump; the written sequence runs to its end with sound; Alles stoppen silences a running chain (peak < 0.002 afterwards); combat hits (hull_light x3) come from alternating sides.
The chain check also follows the cue the real manifest now carries for cruise_charge (one cue exists in the live manifest).
npx tsc -p packages/client --noEmit: no output, exit 0; auditionPlugin.ts is in the compiled file list.

Screenshots 1280x720 opened and read: stage-header-de.png (cropped header), library-changed-mark.png, scene-fold-running.png, library-category-engines.png, engine-group.png. Fixed after looking: the save status wrapped onto its own row in the second header bar, so it moved into the stage bar; the header crop included the counter row, now cropped tighter.

My vite on 5184 stopped (both the npx wrapper and the vite child), curl returns 000. Ports 8420, 8421, 5183, 5190 not touched. assets/audio/ratings.json is unchanged in git status and no backup file is left beside it.
notVerified: Nothing was listened to. Whether the HRTF placement, the 3.5 kHz behind-filter, the 0.25 baked send and the default Room 1 sound right is the owner's ear; the measurements only show direction, level and tails.
The HRTF level difference is only asserted as right > 1.2x left for a 440 Hz tone; real sounds are broader and will separate more.
Chromium only; Firefox and Safari panner behaviour (StereoPannerNode, HRTF PannerNode) not tried.

The real combat hit files and fold files were not measured per channel; hits are one channel per the spec (the check asserts numeric azimuths for impact_hull_light, which passed, so it is one channel today).

The cue of the whole fold chain with the real manifest cues (fold_charge and fold_jump had none when tested besides the doctored 2 s) was only checked against what the manifest says at run time, not by ear.
The screenshots use test_right and test_free rows (generated test sounds) for the changed mark; the owner's real 10 changed rows were not screenshotted because the check never touches his ratings.
openIssues: Level match: equal-power panning puts a centred one-channel sound at -3 dB per channel, so Stereo is about 3 dB lower in total power than Mono for those sounds and the Mono/Stereo comparison is not level-matched. Left as is; a +3 dB compensation would be one constant if the owner wants it.
Two-channel files (shield hits and other energy sounds once re-rendered, engine loops) cannot change sides by design; scene directions only act on one-channel files.

Hashes are live in the manifest now (114 of 114 have one). Any rating given before this change carries no hash and is compared with round 1: a sound re-rendered since round 1 shows 'changed' even if the owner rated it again on a newer file before this page stored hashes. That follows the brief; the first re-rate fixes it.
The 'unrated'/'changed' filters combine as a union when both are on.
Without AUDITION_RATINGS_FILE the check refuses to run (exit 2); the brief's literal command no longer works for this reason. The server for the check must be started with the same variable.
The scratch copies of the files that I staged in the session scratchpad are stale (later edits went straight into the tree); do not copy from them.
Mono mode sums everything at the master (rooms included); the reverb in Mono is therefore mono as well, not the stereo room it had before.
